_eligibility_text:
1. The candidate must be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The candidate should belong to one of the following categories: Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), Extremely Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS), or Minority category.
   1. The annual income of the candidate’s parents/guardians (including the candidate’s income, if applicable) must be less than ₹8.00 lakh, or the candidate&#39;s parents must be State Government employees receiving a salary up to Level-11 of the Pay Matrix.
   1. The candidate should not have previously availed the benefits of this scheme.
   1. The candidate must possess the minimum qualifications required for the competitive examination.
